database_models.name: AuditEntry
database_models.description: Tracks audit information for entity changes including what was changed, when, and by whom

database_models.name: ChangeRequest
database_models.description: Represents a change request submitted by a user for a specific checking window and pupil

database_models.name: CheckingWindow
database_models.description: Represents a checking window period during which pupil data can be checked and changed

database_models.name: ContentBlock
database_models.description: Reusable content blocks that can be embedded in wiki pages or other parts of the application

database_models.name: ContentBlockVersion
database_models.description: Version history for content blocks, tracking all changes over time

database_models.name: Country
database_models.description: Represents country information, likely used for pupil data or school locations

database_models.name: Pupil
database_models.description: Pupil data for a specific checking window (currently KS4 June). Contains pupil demographics and performance information

database_models.name: Setting
database_models.description: Application configuration settings stored in the database

database_models.name: WikiPage
database_models.description: Wiki pages for help content and documentation, supporting hierarchical structure, versioning, and soft deletes

database_models.name: WikiPageVersion
database_models.description: Version history for wiki pages, tracking all changes and allowing page reverts
